name: extract_lines
title: Extract Lines
description: Copy a line range from one file and append it into another without retyping it — moving code between files, splitting modules. The source is left untouched; to move, follow with a batch_edit that removes the range.

append_line.description:
Where to append in the target: 0 = beginning, -1 = end, N = after line N, or a line
id (verified against the target).

append_path.description: Target file the lines are appended to (ssh://user@host:port/path for remote).

from_end.description: Last line to copy (inclusive): integer or line id. Default: `from_start`.

from_start.description: First line to copy (inclusive): integer or line id (verified against the source).
